hints.title: Independent Dual Constraints
hints.text: The total containers that can be loaded are independently bounded by the deck grid dimensions and the total ship weight capacity.

hints.title: Grid Cell Capacity
hints.text: An n by n cargo deck has room for at most n squared containers.

hints.title: Weight Capacity Limit
hints.text: Given maximum total weight and unit container weight, the ship can hold at most floor(maxWeight / w) containers.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct integer division and minimum computation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Looping through containers one by one is unnecessary when direct arithmetic gives the answer.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify the bounding limits and compute the result using integer arithmetic.
